title: Seoul shares surge 3% on renewed AI optimism, easing oil prices
caption:
Seoul shares saw a major surge on Tuesday, triggering a rare market circuit breaker. Driven by renewed AI interest and falling oil prices, tech stocks led the rally.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul shares surge 3% on renewed AI optimism, easing oil prices
